claims.scope: ### W<n> weaknesses of the eic, methodology, domain and perspective seats; DA CRITICAL and MAJOR rows
claims.inventory_rule: extract with --expect-bundles 17 --expect-claims 805; build refuses an inventory whose summary has any problem or whose counts differ

codex.settings: codex exec, model_reasoning_effort=xhigh, read-only, empty working directory, prompt on stdin

gemini.settings: agy -p, model 'Gemini 4 Argon (High)', empty working directory

prompt_budget_rule: a first attempt is at most prompt_budget_bytes, so a retry with its note stays at most prompt_limit_bytes; agy fails silently above about 30 KB

contrast_pairs.acceptance: every mechanical check and every one of the seven verifier questions is true; per fixture between min_accepted_per_fixture and per_fixture_requested pairs; no repeated pair id or sentence; build refuses anything else

contrast_gate.rule: per judge, with a verdict for every contrast item in every replicate (a missing one fails the gate): a false sentence is detected only when both replicates say false; an accurate sentence is flagged when either replicate says false

item_flag_rule: per judge and claim: missing when a replicate has no readable verdict; true when both replicates say false and each false passes the mechanical evidence check; false when no replicate says false; unresolved otherwise. true against not_verifiable does not change the flag

adjudication.items: every claim in an adjudicated list
adjudication.record: adjudication_decisions.json (verdict and criterion id per claim); score never overwrites it

decision_rule.build_part_two_when: both judges pass the contrast gate, and the false-claim rate is at least 0.03 or the share of panels with a false claim is at least 0.30

stop_rules: a judge that fails the contrast gate is void; with one valid judge the run is exploratory; with none it is void
the claim inventory differs from expected_counts or has an extraction problem: stop before any judge call
fewer than min_accepted_per_fixture accepted pairs for any fixture, or any other pair problem: stop before any judge call on claims
a batch whose output cannot be read after its one retry: stop the run
a transport failure (nonzero exit, empty output, usage limit, authentication): stop the run, never retry
an interrupted call (a lock without an output), or an input changed since the build: stop
no replacement model or transport without a new plan version

agreement_lists.rule: each claim falls in the first list that fits, from the flags of the valid judges only (rubric.md, Agreement)

validity.two_valid_judges: decision_relevant: the headline and the decision rule apply
validity.one_valid_judge: exploratory: per-judge counts publish, no headline rate, the decision rule does not apply

report_construction.per_item_payload: per valid judge: {item_id, is_false} with is_false true, false, or null (unresolved or missing); contract divergent_items are recomputed from this payload
report_construction.headline: adjudicated false claims (agreed_false plus adjudicated items decided false) / 805; estimand_status point_estimate; resolution_direction bidirectional
report_construction.spread: raw false-verdict counts per judge per replicate, and their difference, publish beside the headline
report_construction.coverage: per judge and replicate, claims with no readable verdict; any gap is named in attempts.blocked_runs and sets partial_published true
report_construction.raw_outputs: every call's output, prompt hash, and the execution manifest built from calls.jsonl

headline.false_claim_rate: adjudicated false claims / all claims, overall and by seat (seat joined from key.jsonl after scoring)
headline.panels_with_false_claim: share of the 17 panels with at least one adjudicated false claim
